answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 62 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in crystal, queued in thread, and pulse publishes the wait time. A farm of 87 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3158 identities would post 2684 proofs and burn roughly 42 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
